observation: Front, top and iso inspected. Plain round disc, perfectly circular outline with no tail, tab, notch or projection. Front view shows the 1.0 mm chamfer on the man-face edge, the square-stepped annular rebate and the raised central plateau. Iso shows the sun mark on the plateau: one circular ball pocket dead centre with eight separate wedge pockets round it, each visibly wider at the inner end and narrowing to a blunt flat tip, none touching the ball or each other. No comet outline and no orbit-crown ring remain.
